After cards are selected, they should calculate the payback and the new energy performance level (EUI). Push the teams along such that they can discuss their results. They may want to cycle back and investigate picking different cards, especially if they did not meet their goals. A key question could be – what are the consequences of an organization not achieving their goals? Ultimately, this exercise is foundational to creating an overall plan to meet organizational goals. Challenge them to decide how they will meet their goals, especially if this building retrofit does not. Individual buildings that don’t hit the goals put an additional burden on the rest of the portfolio. Report Out Ask the table what they have learned from this process.
